subject: Trial next steps / procurement path (PO vs card) & billing start
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Trial procurement path

Alex — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can get your trial running and aligned to procurement: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: Validate LLM-powered search assistant for product docs and measure latency/cost at 5k–10k weekly queries.
- Success criteria discussed: ~90% relevance on a 100-sample eval, median latency < 300ms for interactive flows, and sustained throughput of ~50 rps during peak tests.
- Team: Alex (ML lead), Samantha (procurement), and internal engineering + product.

Procurement / commercial path options we covered:
1) Corporate card (self-serve): fastest to start (instant), but limited to payment card limits and our billed usage model.
2) Purchase Order (PO) / net-30: procurement-friendly, requires SOW + invoice; typical lead time ~1–2 weeks once PO is raised.
3) Marketplace (AWS Marketplace): if you prefer to purchase via marketplace, we can provide listing details — billing is consolidated via AWS and can simplify procurement for some finance teams.

Documents attached: Acme-trial-plan.pdf (technical onboarding + timeline). I can also share an SOW + pricing sheet if you prefer to go the PO route.

Proposed trial timeline & billing trigger:
- Start trial onboarding: target week of May 18 (dev onboarding + dataset ingest).
- Trial evaluation window: 3 weeks (May 18 — June 7).
- Billing start (trial-to-paid): If success criteria met, we propose billing to start on June 8. If you need billing to start on invoice receipt instead, we can accommodate — just let us know.
- Usage threshold for conversion: recommended minimum of 100k tokens OR 10k inference requests (whichever shows stronger signal for your use case) during the trial window to consider conversion. We can adjust after we see initial telemetry.

Next steps (please confirm):
- Alex: confirm preferred commercial path (card vs PO vs marketplace).
- Samantha: if PO, please share procurement contact + PO templates and any required billing fields.
- Dev Patel (cc): we’ll loop you on SSO/ingest timelines — can you confirm if you need a dedicated staging environment?

I’ll follow up with a draft SOW & pricing sheet (if PO) and a DocuSign link if you want to fast-track signatures.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme-trial-plan.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Trial procurement path

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement preference: Our finance team prefers to purchase via PO (net-30) rather than corporate card. That said, if marketplace purchase (AWS) is available and shows equivalent pricing, finance will consider it — it often simplifies paperwork.
2) On SOW & pricing: please send the SOW and a one-page pricing summary we can share with procurement.
3) Success criteria: the metrics you listed look right. One add: we want to ensure RBAC + audit logs for evaluation (risk/compliance). Who on your side can confirm the audit/logging options?

We’re targeting a May 18 onboarding as well. If PO approval takes longer, can we start engineering onboarding prior to PO issuance and then switch billing later?

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of ML, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

Date: Sat, 15 May 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Trial procurement path

Alex / Samantha — great, thanks for the clarity. Answers below and attaching SOW + pricing.

- PO path / pre-onboarding: Yes — we can start technical onboarding (dataset ingest, SSO config, sandbox testing) ahead of PO issuance. We’ll mark the environment as trial and keep billing paused until you instruct otherwise. If a PO is later issued and you want billing retroactive to trial start, we can discuss on a case-by-case basis (finance dependent).

- Audit logs & RBAC: Neha (cc) is our security lead for onboarding — she’ll confirm the log retention and audit options. For the trial we provide per-token telemetry, per-route logs, and an audit log for API key activity. Longer-term retention can be configured in Dedicated/Private options.

- SOW & pricing: attached SOW-draft.pdf and pricing-sheet.xlsx. The pricing sheet includes: trial / evaluation credits, card pricing, net-30 pricing tiers, and marketplace listing notes.

- Proposed trial thresholds (we can tune):
  * Minimum evaluation signal: 100k tokens OR 10k inference requests during the 3-week window.
  * Performance target: median latency < 300ms for interactive endpoints.
  * Quality target: relevance >= 90% on a 100-sample eval set you provide.

- Billing start: default proposal — June 8 if success criteria met. If your procurement requires billing to start on invoice receipt or PO effective date, flag that and we’ll adjust.

Next steps I’ll take this week:
- Send DocuSign for SOW if you’re ready.
- Dev Patel will schedule an onboarding call for May 18 (30–45 min) to confirm data ingest and test plan.

@Dev — can you propose a 30-min slot for Monday/Tuesday next week?

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, pricing-sheet.xlsx

Marissa — thanks. A couple procurement questions from our side: 

1) PO requirements: Our AP team requires the following on the SOW/invoice: company legal name, billing address, tax ID, purchase order number field, and payment terms (net-30). Can you confirm you can supply those?
2) Marketplace: is Redwood listed on AWS Marketplace? If so, please send the marketplace SKU & listing link — our procurement prefers marketplace purchases where possible as they route through our existing AWS contract.
3) Contact for PO issuance: please provide the email and billing contact we should put on the PO.

If we can get the SOW with the required fields, I’ll kick off the PO — likely a 5–8 business day cycle. We still want onboarding to begin next week, so your pause-the-billing approach sounds good.

—Samantha
